status: Closed — candidate-provenance admission repair verified in source and frozen runner
area: Sealed runner publication rechecks unrelated live source WIP
finding: The runner is built from a detached sealed candidate, but the final publication admission re-reads live source paths and blocks on another task's dirty packages/** or scripts/** files. That work cannot affect candidate bytes, so the gate serializes ordinary development for longer than the actual shared publication mutation and recreates a bootstrap circularity.
expectedBehavior: Source-conflict policy must follow candidate provenance. Live-worktree builds may block on conflicting source WIP; sealed-detached builds must retain conflicts as diagnostics but only serialize the short mutation of shared runner output surfaces. The queue must be acquired at the publication boundary and released immediately afterward.
evidenceOrRepro: run-sealed-runner-build.ts constructs the candidate in a detached worktree before ensureRunnerPublicationReservation. ATM-GOV-0364 source WIP was absent from the sealed commit yet runner-sync-admission returned ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_FOREIGN_WIP_BLOCKED during publication, preventing a previously built candidate from publishing. Publication verified on 2026-08-14 against the runner's own declared input: release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 records sealedSourceCommit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b with buildDecision fullRebuild and payloadReuse false, so the packed runner was rebuilt from that commit rather than reusing an earlier payload. This item cites no fix commit, so the commit was inferred rather than quoted: the last change to packages/cli/src/commands/framework-development/runner-sync-admission.ts is c3b27f6438d40fc6159640eb0cf299b063e653de, an ancestor of the sealed source commit. Corroborated inside the published tree by direct symbol: packages/cli/dist/commands/framework-development/runner-sync-admission.js at 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 contains the sealed-detached candidateSourceIsolation branch this item asked for, which is the discriminating behaviour rather than a filename match.
followUp: Closed on 2026-09-05. The current frozen runner source seal includes candidate-provenance admission and the focused live-worktree/sealed-detached regressions remain part of the committed validation surface.
